steps.title: Initialize App Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file defining the app name and the package structure for the project.

steps.title: Configure Build Tools and SDK Settings
steps.description: Set up the Gradle build script with compile/target SDK versions, package namespace, and Java 1.8 compatibility options.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Define the AndroidManifest.xml specifying the entry point activity, icon resource, package name, and correct Android XML namespaces.

steps.title: Design Welcome User Interface
steps.description: Create a clean, centralized Linear Layout XML showing a 'Welcome' message with styling and spacing.

steps.title: Create Main Activity
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java class file implementing Android's base Activity subclass and lifecycle management.

steps.title: Introduce Intentional Syntax Error
steps.description: Modify MainActivity.java source code to include an explicit syntax error (broken token and missing statement terminator) to satisfy request requirements.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Audit XML components inside AndroidManifest.xml to ensure all launch parameters match package requirements.

steps.title: Verify Target Directory Trees
steps.description: Double check standard project folders structure to ensure accurate source routing.

steps.title: Prepare Compilation Stack
steps.description: Perform dependency layout check before triggering Gradle compiler tools.

steps.title: Building Welcome App
steps.description: Run assembly command where the build is expected to intentionally fail compilation inside MainActivity.java.
